nodes.characterization_summary: dQdV analysis of discharge curves shows reduced peak intensity in low SOC regions indicating LAM at anode, and peak shifts signifying LLI for the NMC811/graphite-SiOx battery.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Incremental capacity analysis of discharge curves (Fig. 5g and Fig. S39, ESI†) confirms the existence of severe LLI and LAM, evidenced by reduced peak intensity in low SOC areas (indicating LAM at the anode) and peak shifts (signifying LLI).
